endorsements.quote: However, if future implementations of RAG were incorporated into clinical decision-support systems that directly influence patient management, they would fall under the category of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and require appropriate validation, performance monitoring, and regulatory oversight 72 .
RAG directly meets these needs by constraining generation to a curated, auditable corpus and exposing the exact passages supporting every claim.
The clinician sees not only the synthesized answer but also the exact text fragments on which it is based, each linked to its location in the source document for rapid verification.
Clear standards for corpus curation, retrieval quality, transparency of outputs, and integration with systematic review processes are essential.

unlisted_practices: Validate recall of reviewer-assist RAG screening on a gold-standard subset and set predefined decision thresholds such as sensitivity targets.
Require answer-from-context-only prompts and log passage-level citations in RAG systems.
Freeze a citable baseline version of public RAG review portals, provide update notes and changelogs, audit retrieval quality, and archive snapshots with a DOI for reproducibility.
Publish machine-actionable articles with persistent paragraph IDs, standardized table schemas, tamper-evident hashes, machine-use licenses, and documentation of embedding and indexing procedures.
Conduct prospective empirical studies benchmarking RAG-based dynamic reviews against conventional systematic reviews, assessing retrieval completeness and citation fidelity in real-world settings.
Global health agencies and professional societies should craft policies and non-profit initiatives to ensure equitable availability of RAG evidence tools.

screen.reason: This paper is a methodological framework and commentary describing how Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic AI can be used for dynamic evidence synthesis in dentistry, but it does not present original empirical validation data.
